_comment: News source registry for the §3.11 editorial-news module. Each source is fetched by news_collector.py, classified by news_classifier.py, and stored via POST /api/admin/news. Legal rule (see NEWS_MODULE.md): we store headline + our own LLM summary + link + source + timestamp only, NEVER the source's full article body. 'coverage_weight' feeds the source-weighted tone aggregation required by TZ §3.3.

_legend.type: rss | openinfo | html | telegram — the fetcher to use
_legend.content: full = feed ships whole article (we still store snippet only); snippet = title+summary+link; none = no feed, scrape sitemap
_legend.legal: safe = reuse with attribution/link-back OK; caution = snippet+link only, respect crawl rules; avoid_fulltext = ToS bars reproduction, headline+link only
_legend.coverage_weight: 0..1 relative audience/authority weight for tone aggregation
_legend.crawl_delay_s: minimum seconds between requests to this host
_legend.max_items: per-source cap on items fetched per run, tighter than the CLI --limit (which still applies as the ceiling). Use it on whole-site feeds whose extra volume is mostly non-market news.
_legend.page_image: true = feed ships no image, so read the article page's own og:image preview tag (head only, image URL only). Omit/false when the feed already carries media:*/enclosure images, or when the page's og:image is one site-wide share card that would repeat down the feed.
_legend.feed_image: false = do NOT use even the image the feed ships (source ToS bars reuse of its media). Defaults to true.

sources.name: openinfo.uz — material facts
sources.notes: Primary issuer channel, LIVE since 2026-07-25: GET /disclosure/facts/ (newest-first, 64k+ filings, ~21/day across all ~790 filers, of which ~7/day are our listed issuers). Attributed by openinfo organization id via catalog_companies.org_id — 68 of 93 tickers have one; filings from unmapped issuers are logged and skipped, so backfilling those org_ids widens coverage. Same-issuer/same-fact-type/same-day filings are grouped into one card. Facts are marked always_relevant (skip prefilter + triage) with their tickers and §3.11 class taken from the filing itself. Covers dividends (42/50), profit-distribution recommendations (49), issuance (25/26), listing/delisting (46/47), large and affiliate deals (20-22), ownership crossings (51-53), management changes (8/9), bankruptcy (34). Reuse permitted with link-back.

sources.name: Central Bank of Uzbekistan
sources.notes: Policy-rate decisions and FX policy. Read from the press-centre listing, not the RSS: verified 2026-07-25 the feed carries a SINGLE entry (all three language variants), so a second release published between runs is lost, while the page lists ten. The listing renders an empty news__text and the article pages have no og:description, so CBU items are title-only by the publisher - do not chase a blurb. Per-article thumbnails do come from the listing; page_image stays false because its og:image is one site-wide social.jpg.

sources.name: Republican Stock Exchange Toshkent (UZSE)
sources.notes: Exchange news: listings, suspensions, new members. robots.txt bans AI-labelled UAs (GPTBot etc.) and requires a 60s crawl-delay; send a browser-style UA, never an AI-labelled one.

sources.name: Kursiv Media Uzbekistan
sources.notes: Whole-site feed (100 entries, ~79h deep): sports/entertainment/horoscopes alongside business, ~14-23 new items/day. Capped at 25 per run — raised from 15 when the schedule went to once daily, since one run now has to cover a full day's output rather than half of it. Feed ships full text; store snippet only. No featured image in the feed, but each article page exposes a real per-article og:image.

sources.name: Spot.uz
sources.notes: OOO Afisha Media, registered e-media #1207 (2019). Business focus. Feed ships its own images as rel=enclosure links (verified 2026-07-25: 10/10 items), so no page fetch is needed.

sources.name: Kun.uz
sources.notes: Largest general-news audience. Feed URL re-verified 2026-07-25: only /news/rss and /api/rss return XML — /ru/news/rss now serves the Next.js HTML page (feedparser got 0 entries), which is why this source produced nothing. Items are Uzbek. Feed carries no image; the article page has an og:image.

sources.name: UzDaily.uz
sources.notes: Business daily. Enabled 2026-07-25: /rss serves Russian items, 20/20 with their own image, 20/20 dated, clean titles/snippets, and a high share of market news (bank assets, mortgage volumes, IMF missions, stablecoin rules) — denser signal than kursiv's whole-site feed. robots.txt explicitly allows ClaudeBot/GPTBot.

sources.name: Review.uz
sources.notes: Analytical journal, carries CERR pieces. Deferred.

sources.name: UzA — National News Agency
sources.notes: State news agency — authoritative for decrees. Deferred.

sources.name: Gazeta.uz
sources.notes: Major outlet. ToS: 'Materials may not be reproduced or distributed without prior written permission.' Headline + link + attribution ONLY, never store any article text. Feed does ship images (10/10), but under this ToS do not display them without permission — keep page_image off and treat the feed image as unusable too. Deferred.

sources.name: Daryo.uz
sources.notes: No RSS; permissive robots (only /preview/ blocked). Needs an HTML scraper. Deferred.

sources.name: КорпИнфо (Telegram)
sources.notes: ~8.3K subs, Uzbekistan capital-market wire. Read-only via public web mirror t.me/s/. Treat as a LEAD source: confirm against an openinfo fact or outlet feed before showing to users. Deferred.

sources.name: Moody's Ratings
sources.notes: Rating actions on Uzbek issuers and the sovereign. Verified 2026-07-25: Moody's publishes no usable feed, but ratingsnewsmap.xml is a rolling window of ~183 GLOBAL actions with the headline in the URL slug, and robots.txt permits it. url_filter is applied before any model call, so the ~99% naming no issuer of ours costs one shared HTTP request and nothing more. Headline only - the article pages return a 2.7KB SPA shell, and no page is opened anyway. No lastmod on these entries, so items arrive undated (kept by _is_recent, right for a window of current actions). Expect roughly one hit a week or two. Sister agencies are NOT reachable: spglobal.com answers 403 to every automated request including robots.txt, and fitchratings.com serves its content from /page-data/, which its own robots.txt disallows.
